newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys early Feb diesel, jet from Shell.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys early Feb diesel, jet from Shell.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil and jet fuel from Shell for Feb 4-5 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo, traders said on Thursday.
The 180,000 barrels of gas oil were bought at 69 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, while the 120,000 barrels of jet fuel were purchased at 64 cents premium to Singapore spot quotes.
Sri Lanka has also issued a new tender to buy the same volumes of gas oil and jet fuel for February 13-14 delivery, c-nad-f Colombo. The tender closes on January 29.

In a previous tender, CPC bought from Glencore 185,000 barrels of gas oil at $1.50 per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel at a $1.60-premium, for January 23-27 delivery, c-and-f Colombo.
Sri Lanka is buying more middle-distillates lately to make up for shortages during the current five-week maintenance shutdown at its 60,000-barrel-per-day Sapugaskanda refinery.
